name: Chile
famous_for: Atacama Desert (driest on Earth), Torres del Paine granite peaks in Patagonia, Moai statues, and wine.
tourists: Over 4.5M visitors; top sights include Torres del Paine, San Pedro de Atacama, and Valparaíso.
must_know: The Cueca is the spirited national courtship dance, danced with handkerchiefs twirled in the air.
fun_fact: Chile is the longest north-to-south country in the world, extending 4,270 km while averaging 177 km wide.
